data.narrative:
Skeleton Technologies is a Series E climate and energy company that has raised €392M to date across its funding rounds. The valuation analysis is situated within a broader frontier-tech landscape comprising one public comparable (LNZA) and eight private peers in the Climate & Energy sector, including companies such as Redwood Materials, QuantumScape, KoBold Metals, Electric Hydrogen, and Enovix.

The Stage-Progression method is the primary applicable valuation approach. Using total capital raised (€392M) as a proxy baseline and applying a 1.4x step-up multiplier typical of Series E-to-later-stage progression yields an implied valuation of €549M. The Peer-Median method was not applicable due to insufficient narrow-set comparables; while eight same-sector peers exist, none met the thresholds for same-stage, adjacent-stage, or similar-valuation-tier clustering required for reliable median derivation.

The analysis supports a valuation range of €466M (conservative) to €631M (high), with a median point of €549M. This narrow range reflects reliance on a single method rather than triangulation across independent approaches. The primary uncertainty stems from the absence of true peer-stage multiples in the Climate & Energy sector, leaving stage-progression assumptions unvalidated against market comparables. Additional revenue multiple or comparable transaction data from the frontier-energy funding ecosystem would strengthen conviction in this valuation band.
